posteriores.texto: Respondendo, Jesus lhe disse: "Simão, tenho algo para lhe dizer." Ele respondeu: "Mestre, diga."
"Dois devedores tinham um certo credor: um devia quinhentos denários, e o outro, cinquenta."

kjv.texto: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.
